// ============================================================================
// ARM64 256-bit Field Multiplication with secp256k1 Reduction
// ============================================================================
// Full 256x256 -> 512 bit multiplication followed by modular reduction.
// Uses ARM64 MUL/UMULH instructions for efficient 64-bit × 64-bit operations.
// Total: 16 MUL + 16 UMULH + reduction operations
//
// Strategy: Schoolbook multiplication into 8 limbs, then apply secp256k1
// reduction using the special form p = 2^256 - c where c = 0x1000003D1.
// ============================================================================
void field_mul_arm64(uint64_t result[4], const uint64_t x[4], const uint64_t y[4]) noexcept {
    // Phase 1: Full 256x256 -> 512 bit multiplication
    uint64_t prod[8]; // Stores intermediate 512-bit product
    
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        // Column 0: prod[0] = x[0]*y[0]
        "mul    v0,  %[x0], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[x0], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "str    v0,  [%[p], #0]         \n\t"
        
        // Column 1: prod[1] = x[0]*y[1] + x[1]*y[0] + carry
        "mul    v2,  %[x0], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v3,  %[x0], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "mul    v4,  %[x1], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v5,  %[x1], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v2            \n\t"
        "adcs   v3,  v3,  xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v4            \n\t"
        "adcs   v3,  v3,  v5            \n\t"
        "str    v1,  [%[p], #8]         \n\t"
        "mov    v6,  xzr                \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        
        // Column 2: prod[2] = x[0]*y[2] + x[1]*y[1] + x[2]*y[0] + carry
        "mul    v0,  %[x0], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[x0], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "mul    v2,  %[x1], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[x1], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "mul    v5,  %[x2], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v7,  %[x2], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "adds   v3,  v3,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v6            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v3,  v3,  v2            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v4            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v3,  v3,  v5            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v7            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "str    v3,  [%[p], #16]        \n\t"
        
        // Column 3: prod[3] = x[0]*y[3] + x[1]*y[2] + x[2]*y[1] + x[3]*y[0] + carry
        "mul    v0,  %[x0], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v2,  %[x0], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "mul    v3,  %[x1], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[x1], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "mul    v5,  %[x2], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v7,  %[x2], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v6            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v3            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v4            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v5            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v7            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  %[x3], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v3,  %[x3], %[y0]       \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v3            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "str    v1,  [%[p], #24]        \n\t"
        
        // Column 4: prod[4] = x[1]*y[3] + x[2]*y[2] + x[3]*y[1] + carry
        "mul    v0,  %[x1], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[x1], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "mul    v3,  %[x2], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[x2], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "mul    v5,  %[x3], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v7,  %[x3], %[y1]       \n\t"
        "adds   v2,  v2,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v6            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v2,  v2,  v3            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v4            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v2,  v2,  v5            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v7            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "str    v2,  [%[p], #32]        \n\t"
        
        // Column 5: prod[5] = x[2]*y[3] + x[3]*y[2] + carry
        "mul    v0,  %[x2], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v2,  %[x2], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "mul    v3,  %[x3], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[x3], %[y2]       \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v6            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v3            \n\t"
        "adcs   v2,  v2,  v4            \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "str    v1,  [%[p], #40]        \n\t"
        
        // Column 6: prod[6] = x[3]*y[3] + carry
        "mul    v0,  %[x3], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[x3], %[y3]       \n\t"
        "adds   v2,  v2,  v0            \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v6            \n\t"
        "str    v2,  [%[p], #48]        \n\t"
        "str    v1,  [%[p], #56]        \n\t"
        
        : /* no output operands -- results stored via pointers */
        : [x0] "r"(x[0]), [x1] "r"(x[1]), [x2] "r"(x[2]), [x3] "r"(x[3]),
          [y0] "r"(y[0]), [y1] "r"(y[1]), [y2] "r"(y[2]), [y3] "r"(y[3]),
          [p] "r"(prod)
        : "v0", "v1", "v2", "v3", "v4", "v5", "v6", "v7",
          "cc", "memory"
    );
    
    // Phase 2: secp256k1 fast reduction
    // p = 2^256 - c where c = 0x1000003D1
    // Reduce high limbs by adding them multiplied by c to lower positions
    
    constexpr uint64_t C = 0x1000003D1ULL;
    
    uint64_t res0 = prod[0], res1 = prod[1], res2 = prod[2], res3 = prod[3];
    
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        // Reduce t[4]: add t[4] * C to result
        "mul    v0,  %[t4], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t4], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        // Reduce t[5]: add t[5] * C << 64
        "mul    v0,  %[t5], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t5], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r1], %[r1], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        // Reduce t[6]: add t[6] * C << 128
        "mul    v0,  %[t6], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t6], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r2], %[r2], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], v1        \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        // Reduce t[7]: add t[7] * C << 192
        "mul    v0,  %[t7], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t7], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r3], %[r3], v0        \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  v1            \n\t"
        // Second-round reduction for overflow in v6
        "mul    v0,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        // Third-round (extremely rare)
        "mul    v0,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        : [r0] "+r"(res0), [r1] "+r"(res1), [r2] "+r"(res2), [r3] "+r"(res3)
        : [t4] "r"(prod[4]), [t5] "r"(prod[5]), [t6] "r"(prod[6]), [t7] "r"(prod[7]),
          [c] "r"(C)
        : "v0", "v1", "v6", "cc"
    );
    
    // Final normalization: if result >= p, subtract p (branchless)
    constexpr uint64_t MOD0 = 0xFFFFFFFEFFFFFC2FULL;
    constexpr uint64_t MOD1 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL;
    uint64_t sub0, sub1, sub2, sub3;
    
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        // Subtract modulus
        "subs   %[s0], %[r0], %[m0]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s1], %[r1], %[m1]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s2], %[r2], %[m1]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s3], %[r3], %[m1]     \n\t"
        // Branchless selection using CSEL
        "csel   %[s0], %[r0], %[s0], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s1], %[r1], %[s1], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s2], %[r2], %[s2], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s3], %[r3], %[s3], cc \n\t"
        : [s0] "=&r"(sub0), [s1] "=&r"(sub1), [s2] "=&r"(sub2), [s3] "=&r"(sub3)
        : [r0] "r"(res0), [r1] "r"(res1), [r2] "r"(res2), [r3] "r"(res3),
          [m0] "r"(MOD0), [m1] "r"(MOD1)
        : "cc"
    );
    
    result[0] = sub0;
    result[1] = sub1;
    result[2] = sub2;
    result[3] = sub3;
}

// ============================================================================
// ARM64 256-bit Field Squaring with secp256k1 Reduction
// ============================================================================
// Optimized squaring exploiting symmetry: a[i]*a[j] appears twice for i≠j.
// Only requires 10 multiplications instead of 16 for full multiplication.
// ============================================================================
void field_sqr_arm64(uint64_t result[4], const uint64_t val[4]) noexcept {
    uint64_t temp[8];
    
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        // Compute cross products (i<j), each appears 2x
        // a[0]*a[1]
        "mul    v0,  %[a0], %[a1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[a0], %[a1]       \n\t"
        
        // a[0]*a[2]
        "mul    v2,  %[a0], %[a2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v3,  %[a0], %[a2]       \n\t"
        
        // a[0]*a[3]
        "mul    v4,  %[a0], %[a3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v5,  %[a0], %[a3]       \n\t"
        
        // a[1]*a[2]
        "mul    v6,  %[a1], %[a2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v7,  %[a1], %[a2]       \n\t"
        
        // a[1]*a[3]
        "mul    v8,  %[a1], %[a3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v9,  %[a1], %[a3]       \n\t"
        
        // a[2]*a[3]
        "mul    v10, %[a2], %[a3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v11, %[a2], %[a3]       \n\t"
        
        // Accumulate cross products into columns
        "adds   v1,  v1,  v2            \n\t"   // col2 += a02_lo
        "adcs   v3,  v3,  v4            \n\t"   // col3 partial
        "adcs   v5,  v5,  xzr           \n\t"   // col4 partial
        "adc    v12, xzr, xzr           \n\t"   // overflow
        
        "adds   v3,  v3,  v6            \n\t"   // col3 += a12_lo
        "adcs   v5,  v5,  v7            \n\t"   // col4 += a12_hi
        "adc    v12, v12, xzr           \n\t"
        
        "adds   v5,  v5,  v8            \n\t"   // col4 += a13_lo
        "adcs   v9,  v9,  v12           \n\t"   // col5 partial
        "adc    v12, xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        
        "adds   v9,  v9,  v10           \n\t"   // col5 += a23_lo
        "adc    v11, v11, v12           \n\t"   // col6
        
        // Double everything (shift left by 1 for 2x cross products)
        "lsr    v12, v11, #63           \n\t"   // col7 = MSB of col6
        "extr   v11, v11, v9,  #63      \n\t"   // col6 x 2
        "extr   v9,  v9,  v5,  #63      \n\t"   // col5 x 2
        "extr   v5,  v5,  v3,  #63      \n\t"   // col4 x 2
        "extr   v3,  v3,  v1,  #63      \n\t"   // col3 x 2
        "extr   v1,  v1,  v0,  #63      \n\t"   // col2 x 2
        "lsl    v0,  v0,  #1            \n\t"   // col1 x 2
        
        // Now add diagonal products a[i]*a[i]
        // a[0]*a[0]
        "mul    v2,  %[a0], %[a0]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[a0], %[a0]       \n\t"
        "str    v2,  [%[t], #0]         \n\t"   // t[0] = lo(a0^2)
        "adds   v0,  v0,  v4            \n\t"   // t[1] += hi(a0^2)
        "str    v0,  [%[t], #8]         \n\t"   // t[1]
        
        // a[1]*a[1]  
        "mul    v2,  %[a1], %[a1]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[a1], %[a1]       \n\t"
        "adcs   v1,  v1,  v2            \n\t"   // t[2] += lo(a1^2)
        "adcs   v3,  v3,  v4            \n\t"   // t[3] += hi(a1^2)
        "str    v1,  [%[t], #16]        \n\t"   // t[2]
        "str    v3,  [%[t], #24]        \n\t"   // t[3]
        
        // a[2]*a[2]
        "mul    v2,  %[a2], %[a2]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[a2], %[a2]       \n\t"
        "adcs   v5,  v5,  v2            \n\t"   // t[4] += lo(a2^2)
        "adcs   v9,  v9,  v4            \n\t"   // t[5] += hi(a2^2)
        "str    v5,  [%[t], #32]        \n\t"   // t[4]
        "str    v9,  [%[t], #40]        \n\t"   // t[5]
        
        // a[3]*a[3]
        "mul    v2,  %[a3], %[a3]       \n\t"
        "umulh  v4,  %[a3], %[a3]       \n\t"
        "adcs   v11, v11, v2            \n\t"   // t[6] += lo(a3^2)
        "adc    v12, v12, v4            \n\t"   // t[7] += hi(a3^2)
        "str    v11, [%[t], #48]        \n\t"   // t[6]
        "str    v12, [%[t], #56]        \n\t"   // t[7]
        
        : /* outputs via memory */
        : [a0] "r"(val[0]), [a1] "r"(val[1]), [a2] "r"(val[2]), [a3] "r"(val[3]),
          [t] "r"(temp)
        : "v0", "v1", "v2", "v3", "v4", "v5", "v6", "v7",
          "v8", "v9", "v10", "v11", "v12",
          "cc", "memory"
    );
    
    // Phase 2: secp256k1 fast reduction (same as mul)
    constexpr uint64_t C = 0x1000003D1ULL;
    
    uint64_t res0 = temp[0], res1 = temp[1], res2 = temp[2], res3 = temp[3];
    
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        "mul    v0,  %[t4], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t4], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  %[t5], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t5], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r1], %[r1], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  %[t6], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t6], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r2], %[r2], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], v1        \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  xzr           \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  %[t7], %[c]        \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  %[t7], %[c]        \n\t"
        "adds   %[r3], %[r3], v0        \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  v6,  v1            \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "umulh  v1,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], v1        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    v6,  xzr, xzr           \n\t"
        "mul    v0,  v6,  %[c]          \n\t"
        "adds   %[r0], %[r0], v0        \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r1], %[r1], xzr       \n\t"
        "adcs   %[r2], %[r2], xzr       \n\t"
        "adc    %[r3], %[r3], xzr       \n\t"
        : [r0] "+r"(res0), [r1] "+r"(res1), [r2] "+r"(res2), [r3] "+r"(res3)
        : [t4] "r"(temp[4]), [t5] "r"(temp[5]), [t6] "r"(temp[6]), [t7] "r"(temp[7]),
          [c] "r"(C)
        : "v0", "v1", "v6", "cc"
    );
    
    // Branchless normalization
    constexpr uint64_t MOD0 = 0xFFFFFFFEFFFFFC2FULL;
    constexpr uint64_t MOD1 = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL;
    uint64_t sub0, sub1, sub2, sub3;
    __asm__ __volatile__(
        "subs   %[s0], %[r0], %[m0]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s1], %[r1], %[m1]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s2], %[r2], %[m1]     \n\t"
        "sbcs   %[s3], %[r3], %[m1]     \n\t"
        // CSEL: branchless selection
        "csel   %[s0], %[r0], %[s0], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s1], %[r1], %[s1], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s2], %[r2], %[s2], cc \n\t"
        "csel   %[s3], %[r3], %[s3], cc \n\t"
        : [s0] "=&r"(sub0), [s1] "=&r"(sub1), [s2] "=&r"(sub2), [s3] "=&r"(sub3)
        : [r0] "r"(res0), [r1] "r"(res1), [r2] "r"(res2), [r3] "r"(res3),
          [m0] "r"(MOD0), [m1] "r"(MOD1)
        : "cc"
    );
    
    result[0] = sub0;
    result[1] = sub1;
    result[2] = sub2;
    result[3] = sub3;
}

// Determine matrix layout: column-major vs panel-major
#if defined(MF_COLMAJ)
	// Column-major addressing helpers
	#define XMATEL_A(X, Y) pA[(X) + lda * (Y)]
	#define XMATEL_B(X, Y) pB[(X) + ldb * (Y)]
	#define XMATEL_C(X, Y) pC[(X) + ldc * (Y)]
	#define XMATEL_D(X, Y) pD[(X) + ldd * (Y)]
#else // MF_PANELMAJ
	// Panel-major addressing via generic XMATEL macro
	#define XMATEL_A(X, Y) XMATEL(sA, X, Y)
	#define XMATEL_B(X, Y) XMATEL(sB, X, Y)
	#define XMATEL_C(X, Y) XMATEL(sC, X, Y)
	#define XMATEL_D(X, Y) XMATEL(sD, X, Y)
#endif
